graph.title: 70127-1 Wolf Legend Beast

edges.method: sword bar holder grips the bar of the 1L bar piece (minifigure weapon, page 2)
shield grip held on the 1L bar piece next to the sword (the minifigure hand holding them is not in the parts list)
the finished minifigure (with sword and shield) is placed on the studs of the 5x2 bracket on the body in step 14; only the 1L bar piece is in the parts list, so it stands in for the minifigure
stickers from the sheet applied to the printed eye brick of the head (stickers also go on the legs and feet)
sticker from the sheet applied to the curved slope of foot 1 (same on feet 2-4 and the leg curved bricks)
paper inserts supplied together with the set (the card carries an online code and is not attached to the model); recorded as a loose pairing with the sticker sheet so it is not left unconnected
tail spike bar pushed into bar holder
clip of bar holder clipped onto the side handle (bar) of the plate at the rear of the body
hip socket of rear leg A onto towball of rear body plate (step 9)
hip socket of rear leg B onto towball of rear body plate (step 10)
hip socket of front leg C onto towball of front body plate (step 11)
hip socket of front leg D onto towball of front body plate (step 12)
ankle socket of rear leg A onto towball of foot 1 (step 13)
ankle socket of rear leg B onto towball of foot 2
ankle socket of front leg C onto towball of foot 3
ankle socket of front leg D onto towball of foot 4
second claw plate: stud pushed up into the free anti-stud under the hip plate of front leg C (step 7)
second claw plate: stud pushed up into the free anti-stud under the hip plate of front leg D (step 7)
clip plate (lower jaw with cheese slope) clipped onto the side handle bar of the head plate (page 28 step 4)
head socket plate onto towball of the neck ball plate on the body (step 14)

notes: Piece counts match the 105-piece parts list: 18 body + 2x8 rear (haunch) legs + 2x12 front (claw) legs + 4x5 feet + 22 head + 3 minifig-accessory pieces + sticker sheet + trading card.

Minifigure body parts (head, torso, legs, armour, green round piece) are on page 2 but are not in the supplied parts list, so they are not recorded. Only the sword, 1L bar and shield from the list are included. In step 14 the minifigure sits on the body, so I joined the 1L bar (the minifigure's accessory) to the body bracket b19 and the shield to the bar as an assumption.

The trading card (b105) is never used or attached in the booklet. To keep the graph in one group it is recorded as a loose pairing with the sticker sheet (b104). That join is an assumption and not a physical connection. The sticker sheet is joined to the pieces it decorates.

Ids follow booklet order: page 2 minifig accessories, body (pp3-6), rear legs A and B (pp7-14), front legs C and D (pp15-24), 4 feet (p25), head (pp27-30). The final steps 9-14 only attach sub-assemblies, so they are recorded as other_joins.

The pictures are small and ambiguous in places. The exact rests_on choices for the body plates (which 2x2 section the rear balls, handle plate and wedge sit on), the head brackets and the arch/curved pieces of the leg are best guesses. The piece types and counts are certain.
In the front-leg claw step the second 49668 tooth plate goes underneath the hip plate. It has no piece below it, so it is joined by an other_join rather than rests_on.
Stickers go on the leg curved bricks, the feet curved slopes and the head. Only one or two representative sticker joins are recorded.
